newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor sees lower second-half result.
newsitem.headline: Usinor sees lower second-half result.

text.p: French steel group Usinor Sacilor said on Tuesday it expected second-half results to be weaker than those of the first half, but would still be positive.

"Taking into account the seasonal nature of Usinor Sacilor's business, the group currently expects the results for the second half to be weaker than the first, but to remain clearly positive," the company said in a statement with first-half results.

It said the steel industry had started the second half of the year in an expectant mood. The period of destocking appeared to have ended, while order books were finding a normal level in most parts of the group. Prices were stabilising in all areas of activity -- with some tending to rise -- after having fallen in the first half of the year.
The steelmaker earlier reported first-half net attributable profit sharply lower at 833 million francs versus 2.36 billion francs a year ago.
